title: Where Do Dreams Come From?
style: flat 2D vector storybook animation; deep indigo/navy night palette; warm cream moonlight accents; minimalist geometric shapes; soft radial glows; subtle grain; NO text in art; vertical 9:16

beats.narration: Ever wonder where your dreams actually come from?
beats.caption:
WHERE DO DREAMS
COME FROM?

beats.narration: Not from some faraway place. From right here, your own brain.
beats.caption:
YOUR BRAIN
MAKES THEM

beats.narration: In REM sleep, the brainstem fires off random sparks of activity.
beats.caption: REM: RANDOM SPARKS

beats.narration: Your cortex, the storyteller, weaves those sparks into a story.
beats.caption:
THE CORTEX WEAVES
A STORY

beats.narration: It pulls from memory and emotion. Familiar faces, impossible places.
beats.caption: MEMORY + EMOTION

beats.narration: A dream is your brain's nightly cinema. Remembering, rehearsing, and making sense of you.
beats.caption: YOUR NIGHTLY CINEMA
